subject: Org proposal: Scenario 3 — consolidation + role clarifications
messages:
From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Cc: mina_haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 4 Apr 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Org proposal: Scenario 3 — consolidation + role clarifications

Team — attaching Scenario 3 for consolidation across runtime and infra squads. High level: remove one intermediate manager layer, consolidate three small pods into two cross-functional pods, and tighten role scopes to reduce overlapping ownership on deployment lifecycle. Key goals: clearer escalation paths, fewer handoffs during on-call, and faster rollouts for Dedicated and Private offerings.

Attachments: scenario3-org-chart.pdf; role-matrix-v2.xlsx; annex-a-communication-draft.md

Please read the short TL;DR below and flag anything that will materially impact live SLAs or ongoing performance reviews. I want to surface risks before we share with HR and affected managers.

TL;DR
- Timing: target announcement window week of Apr 19 (two weeks from now) to align with end-of-cycle calibration meetings.
- People impact: ~6 IC role scope changes, 2 manager role consolidations, 1 potential role reduction that may need voluntary relocation or role-redesign conversations.
- Performance review tie-ins: we must decouple role-scope changes from current ratings where possible; propose separate calibration note to avoid conflating reorg with performance outcomes.

Asks
1) Operations: confirm if we can keep Dedicated rollout unaffected for next three sprints (Markus).
2) HR: Mina, can you review the communication annex and advise on timing for 1:1 sensitive outreach?
3) Leadership: Aditya, do you want this to go to exec sync next Tue before manager brief?

I'll be around most of the day for quick syncs.

—Karthik
Engineering Director, Serving Runtime
Redwood Inference

Karthik — thanks for the write-up and attachments. Quick reads and a couple of clarifying points: 

1) Can we add an explicit note in the annex that any role-level change will be discussed in a dedicated 1:1 before the public announcement? Managers need a script.
2) The role-matrix has some overlapping ownership between "Deployment Owner" and "Runtime Owner" for the reorg. Can we clarify a single RACI for post-deploy rollback and incident lead? That reduces handoffs during on-call.
3) Timing: I agree with Apr 19 window but suggest an internal manager-only dry run on Apr 15 so we can rehearse the sensitive conversations.

Small editorial on the org-chart: please label the leaders by name in the chart, not just role titles — saves time when managers brief their teams.

If Markus confirms Dedicated capacity is safe, I'm comfortable moving this to HR for a sensitive outreach plan next week.

- Lauren
VP, Product (Serving)

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai

Date: Mon, 5 Apr 2027 08:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Org proposal: Scenario 3 — consolidation + role clarifications

Looping in a quick operational read: the consolidation looks feasible but with two caveats.

Caveat A: Capacity — one of the pods we propose to fold contains two senior engineers currently assigned to Dedicated throughput optimizations. Pulling them into the combined pod will temporarily reduce available headspace for the next release; we should explicitly list backfill options (contractor pool, temporary shift of SRE hours).

Caveat B: On-call load — merging pods increases the basket of services a single on-call rotation may need to triage. I recommend adding an interim runbook change and a 6-week pilot window where we monitor mean time to acknowledge (MTTA) and paging noise. If metrics degrade past threshold, we roll back the merge for that service slice.

If Leadership signs off on the pilot approach, I can commit to the Apr 15 dry run and the Apr 19 broader announcement.

—Markus
Senior Director, Infrastructure

Thanks for the thoughtful package. A few executive asks before HR outreach: 

1) Pause any public manager brief until after I review the employee impact table — I want to ensure we have compensation/options for any voluntary role moves.
2) Mina: prepare a confidential list of affected individuals with potential options (lateral move, temporary project assignment, coaching + role-redesign) and estimated timelines for each. Please mark any probationary/performance-flagged folks so we can avoid intersection errors with performance reviews.
3) Karthik & Lauren & Markus: add a one-paragraph business rationale for each consolidation action in the annex so I can present succinctly in Exec sync.

If we get the above within 48 hours, I will commit to the Apr 15 dry run. Otherwise, we should push the announcement a week.

—Aditya
CTO
